title: The Application and Ethical Implication of Generative AI in Mental Health: Systematic Review.
quote: Studies on therapeutic applications (20/79, 25%) investigated GenAI-based chatbots and adaptive systems for emotional and behavioral support, reporting promising outcomes but revealing limited real-world deployment and safety assurance
summary: Revisão sistemática de 79 estudos sobre IA generativa em saúde mental: as aplicações terapêuticas mostram resultados promissores, mas com pouca implantação real e segurança limitada.
